signals.review_reason: 关键功能不可用：`--expand` flag的设计意图是展示完整日志，但实际只显示第一条，多条日志被静默丢弃。用户无法通过CLI完整调试请求内的日志，核心功能名不副实。dashboard数据完整但CLI层截断，属于功能缺陷而非阻断。

source_issues.title: CLI: `vercel logs --expand` only shows first log entry, discards remaining entries from logs[] array
source_issues.evidence: 代码bug已定位：packages/cli/src/util/logs-v2.ts 中仅读取 `row.logs?.[0]`，`logs[1..n]` 全部被丢弃。复现：一个handler中3条console.log仅第一条显示。Vercel dashboard能正确显示所有行，说明API数据存在但CLI只取第一条。

signals.topic: @vercel/hono preset's TypeScript analysis ignores `skipLibCheck: true`, causing build failures on unowned transitive dependency types
signals.summary: The `@vercel/hono` framework preset runs its own per-file TypeScript analysis via `getSemanticDiagnostics()` which ignores `skipLibCheck: true` in tsconfig.json. This causes builds to fail on type errors inside `node_modules` transitive dependencies (e.g. `@badrap/valita` from `@rocicorp/zero`) that the project doesn't control and cannot fix.
aliases: TypeScript build fails transitive deps node_modules
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断：@vercel/hono preset对node_modules中传递依赖的类型文件进行类型检查，忽略skipLibCheck，导致用户无法控制其传递依赖的构建成功与否。工作区自定义buildCommand已成功，但preset额外检查导致整体构建失败，影响使用Hono preset的用户。

source_issues.title: @vercel/hono preset ignores skipLibCheck, fails on transitive dependency types
source_issues.evidence: 用户在Turborepo中使用@hono preset，skipLibCheck: true已配置但preset仍对node_modules中的@d.ts文件进行类型检查。构建失败报错来自 `@badrap/valita` (用户的传递依赖，非直接控制)。本地`tsc --noEmit`通过但Vercel构建失败。Workaround需手动设置`framework: null`失去零配置优势。

signals.topic: Vercel plugin binary resolution on Windows returns extensionless npm shell wrapper, causing false 'CLI not installed' report
signals.summary: On Windows, the Vercel plugin's binary resolution prefers the extensionless npm shell script wrapper (`C:\Users\...\npm\vercel`) which passes `accessSync(X_OK)` but then fails with `ENOENT` at runtime since Windows cannot execute extensionless shell scripts. The function never tries `vercel.CMD` which would succeed, resulting in a false positive 'CLI not installed' error even when Vercel CLI is fully functional.
aliases: Windows plugin false positive CLI not installed
signals.review_reason: Windows用户关键功能不可用：plugin错误地将已安装的CLI报告为未安装，导致Vercel plugin功能失效。用户被误导以为CLI未安装，实际上运行完全正常。root cause清晰：Windows上npm wrapper的extensionless文件无法直接执行，二进制解析顺序错误。

source_issues.title: [Vercel Plugin] session-start-profiler falsely reports 'Vercel CLI is not installed' on Windows
source_issues.evidence: Windows 11用户npm全局安装vercel，CLI运行正常(v50.35.0)，但Vercel plugin报错'IMPORTANT: The Vercel CLI is not installed'。根因：resolveBinaryFromPath返回extensionless npm wrapper，execFileSync报ENOENT后直接返回installed:false，未尝试vercel.CMD。

signals.topic: Non-English keyboard layout input handling failures block core editor interactions
signals.summary: Multiple keyboard input handling bugs prevent non-English keyboard users from using bracket keys, accent characters, and native macOS keybindings. Three separate issues share the root cause of improper keyboard event processing for non-US layouts.
aliases: Accent character entry disrupted by vim keymaps
signals.review_reason: count=3 meets P0 threshold. Three distinct issues all trace to keyboard input event processing failures for non-standard/US keyboard layouts. Impact is user-blocking: non-English users cannot reliably type brackets or accents, and macOS native keybindings are silently ignored. These are not edge cases—a significant portion of Zed's global user base is affected.

source_issues.title: `]` and `[` buttons are not processed correctly on "non-english" keyboard layouts
source_issues.evidence: CTRL-ALT-] does not fire on Russian keyboard layout while CTRL-ALT-V works. Specific key combinations silently fail depending on keyboard language.

source_issues.title: Two-character mappings disrupt accent character entry
source_issues.evidence: When jj is mapped to switch to normal mode in vim, entering accented characters like 'já' immediately after jj fails because the jj sequence intercepts the input.

source_issues.title: GPUI: doCommandBySelector ignores macOS selectors, breaking DefaultKeyBinding.dict
source_issues.evidence: GPUI's doCommandBySelector: intentionally ignores macOS selector parameter, silently dropping DefaultKeyBinding.dict and standard Cocoa text keybindings like ctrl+w for deleteWordBackward.

signals.topic: AI Inline Assistant broken after v0.228.0 regression for OpenAI-compatible API users
signals.summary: The inline AI assistant feature regressed in v0.228.0 and remains broken in v0.229.0 for users of OpenAI-compatible APIs (DeepSeek, custom endpoints). Core AI feature is unavailable.
aliases: Inline assistant broken with OpenAI compatible API
signals.review_reason: Confirmed regression across two consecutive Zed releases (v0.228.0 and v0.229.0) affecting a core AI feature. Although count=1, the regression is explicitly confirmed, affects multiple platforms (MacOS+Linux), and the feature is completely non-functional for the affected user segment. The review_reason provides explicit user-impact evidence, justifying P1 (not P0 due to single issue count).

source_issues.title: AI: Inline assistant not working regression after v0.228.0 with OpenAI compatible API
source_issues.evidence: Inline Assistant does not work for DeepSeek and OpenAI-compatible API on both v0.228.0 and v0.229.0. Affects MacOS and Linux. Clear regression confirmed across two consecutive releases.

signals.topic: Restricted mode dialog overflows screen making project management impossible
signals.summary: When multiple projects are open in a workspace, the restricted mode dialog overflows past the screen boundary. End-of-dialog buttons (including project enable/disable) are unreachable, blocking workspace project management.
signals.review_reason: UI overflow bug with visual evidence. The dialog is completely non-functional for users with multiple projects—critical buttons are unreachable with no workaround. This is a blocking UX defect for multi-project workspace users.

source_issues.title: Restricted mode dialog overflows screen
source_issues.evidence: Dialog extends beyond screen with no scroll mechanism. Buttons at the end of the dialog are completely inaccessible, preventing users from enabling individual projects in multi-project workspaces. Visual evidence attached.

signals.topic: Web account dashboard logout throws console errors and fails to sign out users
signals.summary: Users clicking 'Sign Out' on the Zed web dashboard receive a JavaScript console error and remain logged in. The logout action is completely non-functional.
signals.review_reason: Authentication flow is completely broken on the web dashboard. Users cannot log out of their Zed account—logout action produces a console error and has no effect. While the editor itself still functions, account management is blocked, which is a clear user-impacting failure.

source_issues.title: Web account dashboard logout not working
source_issues.evidence: Clicking 'Sign Out' on dashboard.zed.dev/account throws a JavaScript console error and the user remains logged in. Console error screenshot attached.

signals.topic: External agents ACP update fails due to temp directory rename error on Windows
signals.summary: When Zed agents need an ACP update on Windows (with or without admin privileges), the temp directory rename operation fails, preventing the agent from updating. Users must manually resolve or work around the failure.
aliases: Agent ACP update rename failed Windows
signals.review_reason: Agent ACP update process is completely broken on Windows, preventing the agent from functioning with updated ACP. The error occurs at a critical point in the update pipeline, leaving users with a broken agent state and no automatic resolution path.

source_issues.title: rename external agents temp dir failed when agents ACP need update
source_issues.evidence: Error occurs when renaming temp directory during ACP update on Windows 11. Affects both regular and admin-privileged Zed sessions. Error message: 'renaming C:\Users\xxxx\AppData\Local\Zed\external_agents\registry\opencode\.tmp-github-download-...'
